release_name: v2.4.0 ConsoleFlow — Search Suggestions + TV / API 22 Support
release_body:
## What's New

### Search Suggestions

Typing in the address bar or home page now shows a live suggestions dropdown — same behaviour as Chrome.

- Full-screen overlay slides up when you tap the search bar
- Suggestions update as you type (300 ms debounce)
- Each row has a **↗** button to autofill the bar without navigating
- Supports Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, and Brave suggestion APIs
- Fully navigable with D-pad / TV remote
- Can be disabled in Settings → Browser → Search Suggestions

### Android TV & API 22

- **`minSdk` lowered from 24 → 22** — the app now installs on Android 5.1.1 devices and older Android TVs that previously got a parse error
- Explicit V1 signing enabled for Android < 7.0 devices
- Fixed a crash on API 22 in the download manager
- Search overlay fully D-pad navigable (UP/DOWN/CENTER/Back)

### Bug fixes

- Fixed animation race when rapidly opening/closing the search overlay
- Fixed crash on cold start when search overlay was dismissed before initialization
- New clean search icon on suggestion rows

Full details in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SANDRO00O/ConsoleFlow-mobile/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
